title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN – Oct. 8  - General Reza Talaei-Nik, spokesman for Iran’s Ministry of Defense, made the following statements in Tehran.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN – Oct. 8  - General Reza Talaei-Nik, spokesman for Iran’s Ministry of Defense, made the following statements in Tehran."

""
"=============="

"SOT1, Reza Talaei-Nik, Spokesperson for Iran's Ministry of Defense (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:39): "In terms of production volume, we now have a production system that meets the requirements for a sustained and long-term war. However, since we also had export capacity, we have had export plans in recent years and again this year; in fact, our surplus products are capable of being exported. Actually, after Iran was able to defeat the US and the Zionist regime on the battlefield, the initial demand for exports is gradually increasing. However, we will first meet our own needs and will increase the export of the surplus in the future.""

"SOT2, Reza Talaei-Nik, Spokesperson for Iran's Ministry of Defense (Farsi)-(00:40 - 00:51): "The advancement of air defense for countering small aircraft and drones has reached a point where it has effectively severely reduced the enemy's maneuverability.""

"SOT3, Reza Talaei-Nik, Spokesperson for Iran's Ministry of Defense (Farsi)-(00:52 - 01:30): "If the enemy carries out an attack, they will be put back in their place much more firmly and strongly than in the past, and the enemy's field defeats will be completed in a way that leads to the military eradication of American and Zionist terrorists in the region. As you can see now, their carriers have fled to great distances from this region, and in other areas as well, they are actually in complete doubt and a totally unstable and disordered state. Even if they do carry out an attack, they will not be able to sustain it.
